1: Bea reunites with her estranged sister Phoebe, who wants to save her life with a kidney donation.
Phoebe has gone missing. Bea will do whatever it takes to find her and is put in danger herself.
Bea makes a discovery and realizes that Phoebe is not the only one who has gone missing in Berlin.
Bea becomes a threat to the vampires. Of all people, her own sister makes sure no one believes her.
Bea and Phoebe flee from the vampires and make an astonishing discovery.
Bea delivers proof that vampires are living in Berlin.
Phoebe wants to save dying Bea who is horrified by her proposal and refuses. It drives them apart.
Bea is abducted by the vampires. Can Phoebe save her?
